problem: Real PowerPoint fixtures exposed preset-animation grouping/duration, text hover, native Zoom graphic-frame/namespace, model3d MIME, ChartEx subtotal, Office media-extension/fallback, vector-only SVG, and unified notes-batch gaps. Historical root-property errors were retested and no longer reproduce.
changes: Allow separate behaviors in one preset to share a shape target while rejecting repeated spTgt children within one tgtEl. An omitted preset duration uses the largest direct behavior duration; explicit duration takes precedence. The unrepresentable multi-shape preset projection has a typed UnsupportedContent refusal.
Read both shape hlinkHover and text-run hlinkMouseOver as inert hover actions, retaining resolved internal targets and declared tooltips.

Recognize typed Zoom payloads inside native graphicFrame/graphicData carriers, validate their data URI and local zmPr namespace, and preserve enclosing frame bytes during property edits. Reuse the canonical fragment namespace context and compare relationship IDs/modes independently of derived resolved-target metadata.
Read native ChartEx idx@val subtotals alongside the historical text dialect; reject mixed, duplicate, overflowing and foreign-namespace indices.
Accept Office model/gltf.binary and the historical model/gltf-binary alias. New model assets use the Office spelling; graph and replay byte limits recognize both.

Read p14:extLst media metadata and select a validated internal Office embed when the ISO legacy relationship is external. Preserve both authored relationship identities and never follow the legacy placeholder. Wrong types and external embed targets remain errors.

Allow a valid svgBlip relationship to supply a vector-only picture primary image. Descriptors and deferred image/SVG reads work without a raster a:blip reference; absent or spoofed references remain errors.

Separate coalesced notes planning from main-slide scene loading. A native ink-replay deck without notes now yields PathNotFound at the same first item for single, closure and atomic-batch edits on eager and source-backed owners.

Extend legacy PPT catalog/image regressions to the tracked POT template; add native owner, operations and facade tests for modern PowerPoint variants, source edits/inverses, caption and review metadata, macro preservation and Agile AES-256/SHA-512 rekeying.

verification_scope.root_properties: Native slide visibility, master preservation and all 17 layout-kind reads already pass on the current code; no root-property implementation change was needed.
verification_scope.publication: PPTX Package::to_bytes serializes a new ZIP. Native tests compare every OPC member payload rather than requiring producer ZIP compression/framing to remain identical.
verification_scope.source_edits: Zoom property, GLB replacement, macro-variant title and public POTX/PPSX/PPTM/POTM/PPSM title edits preserve unrelated member bytes and invert to their before state.
verification_scope.encryption: Empty/wrong passwords are typed Password errors; the correct public fixture password exposes AgileAes256Sha512. Rekeying rejects the old password and preserves every clear member; clear outputs stay in memory.
verification_scope.media: Stored GLB, PNG, SVG, MOV and VBA payload hashes are checked. Caption cue times and text, label/language, notes, custom-show/section memberships and modern comment/reply owners are asserted without execution.

limitations: All 494 feature rows remain explicitly partial or uncovered. The 75 indexed fixtures and 82 partial rows do not establish full feature coverage. The 252 historical pending rows retain their evidence/disposition status.
No Office application was run. Edited outputs were reopened by Litchi only; no macros, media, animations, model renderers or external resources were executed.

Animation duration is a direct-behavior preset projection, not a general timeline evaluator. Multi-shape preset projection remains an explicit typed boundary; source timing is retained unchanged for supported reads.
Native existing Zoom frame edits are covered. Fresh detached Zoom authoring and generalized inherited namespace rebinding across detached fragment moves are not native-qualified by this batch.

Vector-only SVG reading is covered; the existing paired PNG/SVG attachment editor remains a separately bounded operation profile. Source-backed MCE picture-ownership refusal cases remain outside this change.

ChartEx numeric data, layout and subtotal metadata are covered, but complete chart rendering and embedded-workbook interpretation remain outside these assertions. GLB bytes and scene preservation do not imply model rendering.

PPTX ink/math/font feature semantics and broader hyperlink projection, source-copy and structural CRUD still need native assertions beyond catalog reads. Word DOC/DOCX and Excel XLSX owning suites, the remaining encrypted specimens, broader XLS/XLSB operations and full release/workspace gates remain active-goal work.
The existing print_the_golden_transcript owner test remains ignored because it is an explicit transcript generator; no new test is ignored.
Vendored zlib-rs emits 77 existing warnings. Changed-package Clippy passes with --no-deps and -D warnings.
